# Caboodles Miami Beat Touch-Up Tote in Neon Pink

Keep your makeup organized wherever your day takes you. The Caboodles Miami Beat Touch-Up Tote combines retro style with practical storage in one compact travel case.

## Compact Design for On-the-Go Touch-Ups

At 8.125" x 5" x 1.9375", this slim tote fits in an average purse or travel bag. Pack it for a beach day, a weekend trip, or a night out, and refresh your look without digging through a crowded bag.

## Organized Storage for Everyday Essentials

Multiple compartments keep cosmetics, jewelry, hair accessories, and craft supplies sorted and easy to find. The Auto-Open tray lifts your items into view, so you spend less time searching and more time getting ready.

## A Mirror Built In

The large fashion mirror lets you check your makeup and hair in seconds, whether you're at the beach or in a hotel room.

## Secure Travel Made Simple

The snap-tight lid keeps your contents closed while you move between destinations.

## Trusted Organization Since 1987

Caboodles has led on-the-go cosmetic organization for nearly four decades. Add the Neon Pink Miami Beat tote to your travel kit and bring a touch of retro flair to your routine.

Shop now and keep your touch-up essentials within reach wherever you go.
